subject: FINDING+CLAIM c6t-rca-opus #2: C6r batch code-reuse picks the WRONG draw's shader (confirmed in source); claiming nord2_metal_bridge.c lines ~2102-2105 + NEW gpu/tests/batch_code_reuse_test.py
body: draw_batch_locked iterates k DESCENDING (for k=count;k-->0) but the C6r reuse (N2MB_C6R_CODE_REUSE) tests dr[k].shader==dr[k-1].shader and then takes prev_vs/prev_fs, which belong to dr[k+1]. Batch [A,A,B]: draw1 runs B's VS/FS code with A's resources/FAU. Batches mix pipelines freely (tegu_jm_batch_draw_reason/batch_compatible never compare shaders), CA batches 1700+ draws/window. Introduced 665a404 (C6r), absent in e5486c6 (C6q). Matches 'broken textures/icons since C6r' and survives the 4 C6r feature switches (it is under TEGU_C6R_CUTS, which C6r-safe left on). Wrong program vs resource table/FAU is also a credible source of the GPU fault. Minimal fix: compare with dr[k+1]. Editing only those two lines of nord2_metal_bridge.c plus a new test file; no build lease needed beyond small host cc (nice 10, -j1).
